senses.gloss:
(ई,) कृती r. 6th cl. (कृन्तति)
To cut, to divide.
r. 7th cl. (कृणति)
To surround, to encompass.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Done, made, performed.
2 Injured, hurt.
3 Fit, proper.
n. (-तं)
1 The first of the four ages of the world, the Satya yug.
2 Fruit, consequence.
adv.
1 Enough, sufficient.
2 Enough, completely finished.
3 Enough, have done, no more.
E.
कृ to do, to injure, &c. affix क्त.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
1 Cut, divided.
2 Desired, sought, wished for.
E.
कृत to cut, &c. affix क्त.

r. 10th cl. (कीर्त्तयति)
To celebrate, to glorify, to render renowned or notorious.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Artificial, factitious, made, not produced spontaneously.
2 Assumed, simulated, not natural.
n. (-कं)
Factitious salt, produced by boiling and evaporating from saline soils.
E.
कृत to cut or divide, Uṇādi affix अक.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
Deceiving, beguiling, fraudulent.
E.
कृत, and कपट deceit.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
Having done or discharged, or being done, (a duty.) कृत done, कर्त्तव्य what was to be done.

mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
Skilful, clever, able.
E.
कृत made, and कर्म्मन् act.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
See कृतकृत्य.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Fixed, settled as to time.
2 Sent or deposited, &c. for a certain time.
E.
कृत, and काल time.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Tied up as a small bundle or brush.
E.
कृतकूर्च्छ a bundle, and कन् added.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
1 Having done or discharged any thing to be done.
2 Having accomplished or attained any object.
3 Contented, satisfied.
E.
कृत done, and कृत्य what was to be done; also कृतकर्त्तव्य, कृतकार्य्य, &c.

f. (-ता)
Success, attainment, accomplishment, the full discharge of any duty or realisation of any object.
E.
कृतकृत्य, and तल् affix; also with त्व affix, कृतकृत्यत्वं.

m. (-टिः)
1 A name of the saint KAŚYAPA.
2 A name of UPAVARṢA, another divine sage.
E.
कृत made, कोटि excellence.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Angry, indignant.
E.
कृत, and कोप anger.

m. (-यः)
A purchaser, a buyer.
E.
कृत, and क्रय purchase.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Having finished or completed any thing in which one was engaged.
2 Having attained any end or accomplished any object.
3 Having fulfilled one's duty.
E.
कृत done, क्रिया work, duty, &c.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Angry, resentful.
E.
कृत, and क्रुधा wrath.

mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं)
Assaulting, attacking, one who tries to kill.
E.
कृत, घात a blow, यत्न effort.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
1 Ungrateful, not acknowledging former good offices.
2 Defeating or rendering vain all previous measures.
E.
कृत what has been done, and घ्न killing, destroying.

f. (-ता)
Ingratitude.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, कृतघ्नत्वं.

m. (-डः)
A boy on whom the ceremony of tonsure has been performed.
E.
कृत, and चूडा a crest, a lock of hair being left on the top of the head.

mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म)
1 Born, produced.
2 Generated.
E.
कृत, and जन्मन् birth.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
1 Grateful, remembering former aid or favours.
2 Observant of propriety, correct in conduct.
m. (-ज्ञः)
A dog.
E.
कृत what is done, and ज्ञ who knows.

f. (-ता)
Gratitude.
E.
कृतज्ञ, and तल् affix; also कृतज्ञत्वं.

m. (-र्थः)
1 A guide to holy places, &c. one who frequents them.
2 A councillor, one fertile in expedients.
E.
कृत, तीर्थ pilgrimage, &c.

n. (-त्वं)
The being done or effected.
E.
त्व, added to कृत.

m. (-रः)
A married man.
E.
कृत, and दार a wife.

mf. (-सः-सी)
A self-engaged servant, a hired servant.
E.
कृत made, (spontaneously,) and दास a slave.

mfn. (-धीः-धीः-धि)
1 Prudent, considerate.
2 Learned, educated.
E.
कृत, and धी understanding.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
1 Defeated, overpowered.
2 Injured, destroyed.
3 Recollecting past transactions.
E.
कृत, and ध्वंस loss.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Lost after being once possessed or acquired.
E.
कृत made, gained, ध्वस्त destroyed.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Ungrateful.
E.
कृत, and नाशक who destroys.

m. (-नः)
A penitent, one who has performed penance or made expiation.
E.
कृत, and निर्णेजन cleansing.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Confident, sure, certain.
E.
कृत, and निश्चय certainly.

mfn. (ङ्खः-ङ्खा-ङ्खं)
Skilled in archery.
E.
कृत done, made, पुङ्ख the feather of an arrow.

mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं)
Done formerly or precedingly.
E.
कृत, and पूर्व्व prior.

n. (-नं)
Ingratitude, forgetting past services.
E.
कृतपूर्व्व, and नाशन destroying.

mfn. (-र्व्वी-र्व्विणी-र्व्वि)
One by whom any thing was done in time past.
E.
कृत done, पूर्व्व formerly, इनि affix of agency.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Behaving gallantly.
E.
कृत, and पौरुष manhood.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Saluting, making or having made obeisance.
E.
कृत, and प्रणाम salute.

mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं)
Active, industrious, persevering.
E.
कृत, and प्रयत्न effort.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Successful, fruitful.
n. (-लं)
1 Result, consequence of an act.
2 A poisonous substance: see कृक्वोल.
E.
कृत, and फल fruit.

mfn. (-हुः-हुः-हु)
Laying hand upon, touching.
E.
कृत, and बाहु the arm.

mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि)
Informed of one's duty, having acquired knowledge.
E.
कृत, and बुद्धि understanding.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Alarmed, apprehensive.
E.
कृत, and भय fear.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Blessed, consecrated.
E.
कृत, and मङ्गल auspicious.

mfn. (-न्युः-न्युः-न्यु)
Angry, offended, indignant.
E.
कृत, and मन्यु anger.

m. (-लः)
A tree, (Cassia fistula.)
E.
कृत made, माल a garland, garlands being made of its flowers; also आरग्वध.

mfn. (-खः-खा-खं)
Skilled, clever, conversant.
E.
कृत done, and मुख chief, principal.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Sounding, singing.
E.
कृत, and रव a sound.

mfn. (-रुक्)
Splendid, brilliant.
E.
कृत, and रुच् light; also कृतरुचि.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Angry, displeased.
E.
कृत, and रुषा wrath.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Excellent, amiable, &c. noted for good qualities.
2 Defined, discriminated.
3 Marked, stamped.
4 Branded.
E.
कृत made, लक्षण a mark, a sign.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Making, was making, made.
E.
कृत, and क्तवतु aff.

m. (-पः)
A penitent who has shaven his head and chin.
E.
कृत, and वाप tonsure.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Altered, changed.
E.
कृत, and विक्रिय change; also कृतविकार.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
Scientific, a philosopher.
E.
कृत, and विद्या knowledge.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Surpassing, astonishing.
E.
कृत, and वित्पय wonder.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Hired as a servant or labourer.
E.
कृत made, appointed, and वतन wages.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
1 Grateful.
2 Knowing, observant.
E.
कृत, and वेदिन् who knows.

m. (-नः)
A plant, a sort of Ghosha with white flowers: see घोष^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161211. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 307,308.

mfn. (-थुः-थुः-थु)
Trembling.
E.
कृत, and वेपथु trembling.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Decorating, adorning.
E.
कृत, and वेश dress.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Annoyed, vexed, irritated. कृत, and व्यलीक pain, &c.

mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति)
Putting forth one's strength or courage.
E.
कृत, and शक्ति power.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
1 Splendid, brilliant.
2 Beautiful, beautified.
3 Dexterous, handy.
E.
कृत, and शोभा splendor.

mfn. (-चः-चा-चं)
Purified, cleansed, freed from the natural dejections, released from conventional defilement, &c.
E.
कृत, and शाच purification.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Laborious, assiduous, persevering, painstaking, making great or continuous exertions.
E.
कृत made, श्रम fatigue.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Making an agreement or appointment.
E.
कृत, and सङ्केत agreement.

mfn. (-र्गः-र्गा-र्गं)
Approximate, united.
E.
कृत, and संसर्ग union.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Initiated, having undergone all the purificatory ceremonies.
E.
कृत, and संस्कार rite.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Distinguished by appropriate marks, devices, &c.
E.
कृत, and सज्ञा a signal.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Contracted, approximated.
E.
कृत, and सन्निधान proximity.

mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं)
Connected, allied.
E.
कृत, and सम्बन्ध alliance.

f. (-का)
A woman whose husband has taken another wife.
E.
कृक made, स with, together with, पत्नी a wife, affix कन्: or derived from सापत्नक, कृतसापत्नका; also कृतसापत्नी, &c.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Abiding, staying, taking up an abode in or with.
E.
कृत, and स्थिति stay.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Recommended to the protection of gods previous to any journey or undertaking.
E.
कृत, स्वस्त्ययन benediction.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Skilled in archery.
2 Clever, skilful, dexterous.
E.
कृत exercised, हस्त the hand; also कृतहस्तक.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Done in part, not completed.
2 Committed and omitted.
E.
कृत, and अकृत undone.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Advanced, proficient.
E.
कृत, and आगम coming.

mfn. (-गाः-गाः-गः)
Criminal, offending, in fault.
E.
कृत done, अगस् crime.

m. (-र्य्यः)
A Brahman who has offered the usual oblations with fire.
E.
कृत, and अग्निकार्य्य fire-sacrifice.

mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं)
1 Marked.
2 Numbered.
3 Branded.
E.
कृत, and अङ्क a mark.

mfn. (-लिः-लिः-लि)
One who joins the palms of the hands, making such a sign of reverence or solicitation, reverent, respectful.
m. (-लिः)
A shrub used in medicine, also in magical potions, &c.
E.
कृत made, अञ्जलि the hand joined, &c.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
Joining the palms of the hands for the purpose of doing obeisance, also for holding water, &c.
E.
कृत, and अञ्जलिपुट the palms joined.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Subdued, tranquil, of a self-governed spirit.
E.
कृत, and आत्मन् self.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Bending, bowed, paying homage or respect.
E.
कृत, and आनति bowing.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
Kind, favouring, compliant.
E.
कृत, आनुकूल्य favour.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Mixed, combined, united.
E.
कृत, and अनुव्याध mixture.

m. (-रः)
Established practice, usage, custom, rate.
E.
कृत, and अनुसार custom.

m. (-न्तः)
1 A name of YAMA, son of SŪRYA, and regent of the dead, or death personified.
2 Destiny, that is, the inevitable result of actions done in a past existence.
3 A demonstrated conclusion, proved or established doctrine.
4 Sinful or inauspicious action.
5 Saturday, which is considered as an unlucky day.
f. (-न्ता)
A perfume: see रेणुका.
E.
कृत act, (actum) done, अन्त end, destruction.

m. (-कः)
See the preceding.

m. (-कः)
A name of the sun.
E.
कृतान्त YAMA, and जनक progenitor; being the father of YAMA.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Injured, wronged.
2 Discomfited, overpowered.
3 Doing wrong, offending.
E.
कृत, and अपकार offence.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Completing a task, effecting an object.
E.
कृत, and अपदान accomplishment.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Guilty, culpable, an offender.
E.
कृत, and अपराध offence.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Sprinkled.
2 Inaugurated.
m. (-कः)
A prince, &c. who has been inaugurated.
E.
कृत, and अभिषेक sprinkling.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
Successful, having attained an end, having accomplished a purpose or desire.
E.
कृत done, अर्थ object.

f. (-ता)
Success, fruitfulness, accomplishment of an object.
E.
तल् added to the last; also कृतार्थत्व.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Rendered successful.
E.
कृतार्थ, and कृत made, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Become successful.
E.
कृतार्थ, and भूत been, च्चि augment.

m. (-यः)
A frog.
E.
कृत made, आलय abode.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Careful, cautious, prudent, attentive.
E.
कृत, and अवधान care.

mfn. (-धिः-धिः-धि)
1 Fixed, appointed, agreed upon.
2 Bounded, limited.
E.
कृत, and अवधि term, &c.

mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं)
1 Disregarding, effacing from recollection.
2 Intolerant.
E.
कृत, and अवमर्ष impatience.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Seated on the hams with the knees tied together, or the hips and knees surrounded by a cloth.
E.
कृत, and अवशक्थिका the cloth so used.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
1 Summoned, called.
2 Made present.
3 Fixed, settled.
E.
कृत, and अवस्था condition.

m. (-सः)
A lodging, a temporary accommodation, an apartment.
E.
कृत, and आवास abode.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Feeding upon.
E.
कृत, and अशन eating.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Assailing, attacking.
2 Effacing from recollection.
E.
कृत, and आस्कन्दन going to.

mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं)
Armed.
E.
कृत, and अस्त्र weapon.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 Governed, ruled.
2 Supporting, rested upon by any thing.
3 Residing in or on, taking one's abode.
E.
कृत, and आस्पद place, rule.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Having performed the daily ceremonies, or devotions.
E.
कृत, अहन् a day, कन् added.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Summoned, called.
2 Challenged.
E.
कृत, and आह्वान calling.

f. (-तिः)
1 Act, action, acting, doing, &c.
2 Injuring, hurt, hurting.
3 A sort of metre, a stanza of four lines, with twenty syllables in each.
E.
कृ to do, to injure, क्तिन् aff.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 The hide upon which the religious student sits, sleeps, &c. usually the skin of an antelope.
2 The skin.
3 The bark of the Bhojpatra, used for writing upon, for making hooka snakes, &c.
4 One of the lunar mansions: see the next.
E.
कृत to cut, क्तिन् aff.

m. (-रः)
A name of RĀVAṆA.
E.
कृति injuring, कृ to do, ट aff.

mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति)
1 Wise, learned.
2 Clever, skilful.
3 Good, virtuous.
4 Pure, pious.
5 Following, obeying, doing what is enjoined.
E.
कृत done, performed, इनि affix; by whom proper acts are done.

ind.
For, on account of.

mfn. (-र्ष्यः-र्ष्या-र्ष्यं)
Envious, jealous.
E.
कृत, and ईर्ष्या envy.

ind.
Raised on high.
E.
कृत, and उच्चैस्^1 high.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161130. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 301.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Having performed ablutions.
E.
कृत, and उदक water.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Performing penance by standing with uplifted hands.
2 Married.
E.
कृत, and उद्वाह marriage.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Assisted, befriended.
2 Friendly, giving aid.
E.
कृत, and उपकार help.

m. (-नः)
The student invested with the sacrificial cord.
E.
कृत, and उपनयन investiture.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Used, enjoyed.
E.
कृत, and उपभोग use.

f. (-का)
1 The third of the lunar mansions, or constellations in the moon's path, consisting of six stars, and corresponding to the Pleiades.
2 (In mythology,) a nymph; one of six, the nurses of KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
कृत to cut, क्तिन् and कन् affixes; the figure of the asterism is a razor or knife.

m. (-वः)
A name of CANDRA or the moon.
E.
कृत्तिका the constellation, and मव who is born.

m. (-तः)
A name of SKANDA or KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
कृत्तिका, and सुत the son; the nymphs so named being his foster mothers.

m. (-सः)
ŚIVA: see the next.

m. (-सः)
An appellation of MAHĀDEVA.
E.
कृत्ति a skin or hide, and वासस् clothes; clothes with a tiger^1's skin; also कृत्तिवास.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-त्नुः-त्नुः-त्नु)
An artist, an artificer or mechanic.
E.
कृ to make, कत्नु Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
1 To be done or performed.
2 To be rendered murderous or mischievous, hired as an assassin, seduced from allegiance or alliance, hostile through covetousness, &c.
f. (-त्या)
1 Action, act.
2 A female deity, to whom sacrifices are offered for destructive and magical purposes.
3 Magic.
4 A pestilence.
n. (-त्यं)
1 Motive, cause.
2 The class of affixes in grammar forming nouns corresponding to gerunds and supines, chiefly with a passive signification, but sometimes active, and sometimes abstract nouns.
E.
कृत to injure, to divide, &c. क्यप् or यत् affixed, or कृत to injure, वुन् affix, and य inserted.

m. (-कः)
An injurer.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Learned, wise, who knows what is to be done.
E.
कृत्य, and ज्ञ who knows.

n. (-र्त्म)
The right way, the manner in which any object is to be effected.
E.
कृत्य, and वर्त्मन् a road.

mf. (-विद्)
Learned, wise, who knows what is to be done.
E.
कृत्य, and विद who knows.

f. (-धिः)
The way to do any thing, a rule or precept.
E.
कृत्य, and विधि rule.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Made, factitious, artificial, the reverse of what is naturally or spontaneously produced.
m. (-मः)
1 Incense, olibanum.
2 An adopted son, used for कृत्रिमपुत्र.
n. (-मं)
A kind of salt, the common Bit Noben or Bit Lavan,
E.
कृ to make, क्त्रि Uṇādi affix, and मम् added.

m. (-पः)
A compound perfume, containing ten or eighteen ingredients.
E.
कृत्रिम artificial, and धूप resin; also with कन् added कृत्रिमधूपक.

m. (-त्रः)
An adopted son; one of the twelve kinds recognized in law, the son made.
E.
कृत्रिम, and पुत्र a son.

m. (-त्रः)
An acquired friend; one on whom benefits have been conferred, or from whom they have been received.
E.
कृत्रिम made, and मित्र a friend; also similar compounds in this or other senses, कृत्रिमशत्रु an acquired enemy, कृत्रिमौदसीन one who is indifferent to benefits or injuries, neither an acquired friend nor foe.

ind.
Having done, made, &c.
E.
कृ to do, क्त्वाच् aff.

n. (-त्सं)
1 Water.
2 Entire, whole.
E.
कृत to surround, and स Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-त्स्नः-त्स्ना-त्स्नं)
All, whole, entire.
n. (-त्स्नं)
Water.
2 The flank or hip.
E.
कृत to encompass, क्स्न Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-वित् or -विद्)
Omniscient, acquainted with all things.
E.
कृत्स्न all, and विद् who knows.

ind.
Wholly, entirely, altogether.
E.
कृत्स्न, and शम् aff.
